C0685.title: Luotian Man Detained for Reselling Cigarettes Without a License
C0685.summary: In October 2024, the Luotian County Public Security Bureau in Hubei received a case referral from the Tobacco Monopoly Bureau. An investigation revealed that a man surnamed Chen had been purchasing cigarettes in bulk and reselling them without a tobacco business license.
